topic.source_contract: common land village green section 38 consent deregistration exchange works rights

scope_guards: A common-land register entry is not treated as proof of ownership.
Ownership is not treated as freedom to enclose or carry out restricted works.
Planning permission is not treated as section 38 consent.
An asserted exemption is not treated as confirmed exemption.
Deregistration is not treated as completed without the formal decision and register update.
Replacement land identification is not treated as secured exchange land.
Common rights are not treated as extinguished by development proposals.
No score or promotion is written without exact register, rights, consent/exemption, land control, decision and implementation evidence.
